$comment: Machine requirements for repo-mcp. Single owner of this table: src/server.ts renders it for repo_status and --doctor, and ../install.sh reads the same file with jq for `list`. Nothing here installs anything. `gh` is deliberately NOT listed: repo_status reports its presence for the future GitHub integration but no repo-mcp tool uses it today.

binaries.what: the git CLI every tool runs through (shell:false, fixed argv templates)
binaries.install: brew install git  # or on macOS: xcode-select --install
